checks.details: every term has units kg / m ** 3 / s
R = 0 for uniform rho_v and T and a static phi (3 draws, 2 points)
deposition consumes vapor at one ice-like density (draw 2: 1840 kg m^-3) for every phi and rho_v: water is conserved
transport integrates to zero over a period (3 draws): the flux is a divergence

storage: Derivative(-phi(x, y, z, t)*rho_v(x, y, z, t) + rho_v(x, y, z, t), t)
diffusion: -Derivative(-D(T(x, y, z, t))*phi(x, y, z, t)*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), x) + D(T(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), x), x)
-Derivative(-D(T(x, y, z, t))*phi(x, y, z, t)*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), y) + D(T(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), y), y)
-Derivative(-D(T(x, y, z, t))*phi(x, y, z, t)*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), z) + D(T(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), z), z)

storage: (1 - phi(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), t)
diffusion: -(Derivative(D(T(x, y, z, t))*(1 - phi(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), x), x) + Derivative(D(T(x, y, z, t))*(1 - phi(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), y), y) + Derivative(D(T(x, y, z, t))*(1 - phi(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(rho_v(x, y, z, t), z), z))
phase change: (rho_i - rho_v(x, y, z, t))*Derivative(phi(x, y, z, t), t)

agent's symbols.name: rho_i
agent's symbols.meaning: density of ice, taken as constant

agent's symbols.name: D(T)
agent's symbols.meaning: diffusivity of water vapor in the pore gas

agent left out.effect: Thermal expansion of ice (rho_i depending on T)
agent left out.why: The volumetric expansion coefficient is about 1.5e-4 K^-1, so rho_i changes by less than 1% over tens of K

agent left out.effect: Advection by bulk gas flow, including Stefan flow
agent left out.why: Near 200 K the vapor mole fraction is about 1e-6 to 1e-5, so the flow that sublimation drives is negligible next to diffusion
The thermal diffusion factor of water in air is about 0.1 or less, so the term is a small correction to the flux driven by concentration gradients

agent left out.effect: Adsorption on regolith grains and grain motion
agent left out.why: Outside this model of the pore space; the grains are treated as inert boundaries
Folded into the effective D(T); if it matters, D would also depend on pore size
